watches.name: Soloist - Salmon Blue Automatic watch
watches.description: The PAROS Soloist - Salmon Blue has hints of the vintage Baumuster B pilot watches, the Soloist reinterprets a classic utilitarian aesthetic for the modern day watch collector. Why did we name this watch Soloist ? The Soloist is designed for the moment the house lights dim and the spotlight narrows. Inspired by the raw, soaring energy of a final saxophone solo or a definitive guitar riff, this timepiece represents the crescendo that steals the show. It isn’t just an accessory; it’s the definitive closing act. Its versatile 39mm stainless steel case is built for presence without pretense, housing the legendary reliability of the NH35 automatic movement beneath a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal . Bold, technical, and refined we present to you: the PAROS Soloist . Case diameter: 39mm Big screw-down crown Crystal: Sapphire Movement: NH35 Automatic with hacking and hand winding. Lug width: 20mm Band/Bracelet: Blue Leather Click here to learn about wrist watch care & setup. If you like the Soloist in Tuxedo Black , then click here . All our watches are designed and assembled in Pennsylvania, USA. 12 month warranty .

watches.name: Transatlantic GMT
watches.description: The Transatlantic GMT has always been the quintessential traveler’s companion—a watch designed to bridge the gap between time zones and traditions. Now, we are proud to announce the next evolution of this PAROS staple. We’ve kept the soul of the original: the commanding 42mm stainless steel cushion case , the reliable NH34 GMT movement , and the scratch-resistant sapphire crystal . But the details have been refined for the modern explorer. Featuring an all-new dial layout with laser-marked indices and enhanced Lume for legibility in low-light conditions, the new Transatlantic GMT is built to be seen. Complete with updated hands, it is more than just a watch—it’s a statement. Case diameter: 42mm Crystal: AR coated sapphire Movement: NH34A GMT Automatic with hacking and hand winding. Lug width: 22mm Band/Bracelet: Black leather Click here to learn about wrist watch care & setup. All our watches are designed and assembled in Pennsylvania, USA. 12 month warranty .
